capabilities: display a floating emoji mascot that reacts to typing speed
track session words, duration, and words per hour
disambiguation: Not a handwriting or ink-annotation tool; it only tracks typing statistics and displays an emoji mascot.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's word count is a static figure, so writers get no live feedback on their typing pace or session momentum while writing.
summary: Writing companion that tracks session stats (words, time, WPH) and shows a floating emoji mascot that reacts to your typing speed.
